question: Will the July ISM Services PMI show expansion (above 50)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the ISM® Services PMI® headline composite index for July 2026, as reported in the official ISM® Services PMI® Report released by the Institute for Supply Management, is strictly greater than 50.0.
- "No": Wins if the ISM® Services PMI® headline composite index for July 2026, as reported in the official ISM® Services PMI® Report released by the Institute for Supply Management, is 50.0 or below (i.e., at or below 50.0, including an exact reading of 50.0, which is neither expansion nor contraction).

Clarification:
- The figure used is the headline Services PMI composite index as published in the official ISM® report, not any sub-index (e.g., Business Activity, New Orders).

data_sources: Institute for Supply Management (ISM) – Services PMI Report
